resources.string: CarWith video and touch do not need Shizuku; you can connect right away.\n\nTo use legacy virtual displays, physical screen-off or automatic network switching, install the Shizuku app and start its service as its documentation describes (activated over wireless debugging, no root).

CarWith video and touch still connect normally; Shizuku is only used for legacy virtual displays, physical screen-off and some automatic network steps.\n\nIf you need them, open the Shizuku app and tap Start (once again after each phone restart).
mcarplay is not allowed to use Shizuku

CarWith video and touch do not need this permission; you can connect right away. It only affects legacy virtual displays, physical screen-off and some automatic network steps.\n\nIf you need them, tap Request permission and allow it; if you denied it before, allow mcarplay in the Shizuku app under Authorized applications.
